verdict.rationale: LocalAI docs state it auto-detects NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs and downloads the appropriate backend, indicating vendor-specific acceleration support beyond just CPU. However, evidence lacks detail on specific acceleration kernels (e.g., CUDA, ROCm, SYCL) or independent hands-on confirmation that AMD/other vendor paths work reliably in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of AMD/Intel GPU performance, details on specific kernel/backend implementations per vendor, and confirmation beyond doc claims.
